sources.relevant_excerpt: The embassy issues six visa categories: Tourist (Type-T), Business (Type-E), Khmer (Type-K), Courtesy (Type-C), Official (Type-B), and Diplomatic (Type-A). ... "E-Visa (evisa.gov.kh)" ... "Passport must be valid at least six(6) months (based of passport expiration date) prior to their travel entry date to Cambodia." ... Visa exemption: "For ASEAN member and other countries traveling with their valid national passport that does not required visa to enter Cambodia." ... "Issued Visa/s are not refundable or transferable."

"$ 30 in form of Money Order or Cashier Check and have it payable to Embassy of Cambodia." (no personal checks, credit cards, or cash) ... The visa is "valid to use or enter Cambodia within three(3) months from the date of issue" and allows travelers to "stay for 30 days upon entering the Country." ... "Visa can be extended upon entry for another 30 days at Cambodia Immigration Office." ... Required: original passport with at least one blank visa page; completed visa application form with one 2x2 passport photo. ... "Passport must be valid for at least six(6) months (based on passport expiration date) prior to the date of entry to Cambodia." ... Processing: "7-10 working days + return shipping days (for mailing applicant's only)".

passport_validity.condition_text: Passport must be valid at least six (6) months at the date of entry to Cambodia (Royal Embassy of Cambodia in Washington DC, London and Canberra all state this). Blank pages: London and Canberra embassies require at least 2 blank pages remaining; the Washington DC embassy requires at least one blank visa page. The stricter 2-page figure is recorded here.

unresolved: CHN (HUMAN REVIEW REQUIRED): Multiple non-official reports (including China's State Council Information Office english.scio.gov.cn 2025-12-03, Xinhua, and industry alerts) state Cambodia granted a temporary trial visa exemption for PRC passport holders (reported to include Hong Kong and Macao SAR passports and to exclude Taiwan), 14 days per entry, multiple entries, no fee, from 2026-06-15 through 2026-10-15, announced via a Council of Ministers letter signed by standing secretary of state Hing Thoraxy and by the Ministry of Tourism (announcement reported 2026-01-16). This window COVERS the snapshot date 2026-07-23, meaning the CHN dispositions recorded here from official embassy pages (visa required) are likely superseded during the trial window. No reachable Cambodian government page confirmed it: mfaic.gov.kh is WAF-blocked, tourism.gov.kh and arrival.gov.kh render via JavaScript with no static content, and evisa.gov.kh is unreachable (redirect loop). Non-Cambodian sources were not used as evidence per source rules.
